title: rosa gallica f. mirabilis
intro: Rosa gallica f. mirabilis, commonly known as the French rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa gallica plant, a fragrant, pink-flowering rose species native to Europe. The French rose has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and prevent infection. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica f. mirabilis include its ability to calm and sedate, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Rosa gallica f. mirabilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies.
